Joash did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came, and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

people.name: Jehoiada

people.name: Joash
people.line: King of Judah, son of Ahaziah

translations.web: Jehoash did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
translations.bsb: And Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the days he was instructed by Jehoiada the priest.
translations.kjv: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
translations.asv: And Jehoash did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
